representation: One generated payload model, generic typed class wrappers and typed managed arenas; child dispatch and cloning are generated from the same selection.

hooks.SourceFile: Source ownership, text/hash/path, imports and external-module metadata handled by SliceFile/SliceEncoder; top-level statements remain in schema order.
hooks.privateNames: Selected name fields are explicit NodeId payload members; binding/identity belongs to the snapshot, not a duplicated hidden node field.
hooks.Kind: Token and keyword type kinds live in NodeHeader; no runtime generic construction.

outsidePhase1: Other grammar, full AST generation, package/global resolution, control flow, JSDoc, transforms, declaration emit, source maps, language services and all-target shipping are later phases, not implied by these experiment passes.
